name: The Servers Are Shutting Down in 24 Hours but My Pull Rate's Been Set to 0.0001%?!
source:
The servers for Forgelight Moon are shutting down in 24 hours, but Lamona - Witch-in-Training (SSR)'s pull rate has been set to 0.0001%! At this rate, nobody will pull her before server shutdown...

A gacha game end-of-service simulation from the perspective of the gacha.

[From [url=https://npckc.itch.io/server-shutdown]itch.io[/url]]
